definitions.explanation: The state of being alone; can be negative (lonely) or neutral (solitary).

examples.japanese: {孤独|こどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
{孤独|こどく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{孤独|こどく}{死|し}→孤独死：12274_kodokushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧。

notes:
{孤独|こどく} means loneliness or solitude, functioning as both a noun and na-adjective.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {孤独|こどく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (lonely life)
- Noun: {孤独|こどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel lonely)
- Adverb: {孤独|こどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (to live in solitude)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {孤独|こどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧: to experience loneliness
- {孤独|こどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure solitude
- ⟦{孤独|こどく}{死|し}→孤独死：12274_kodokushi⟧: dying alone (social issue in Japan)
- ⟦{孤独|こどく}{感|かん}→孤独感：05995_kodokukan⟧: feeling of loneliness

NUANCE:
Can describe either unwanted loneliness or chosen solitude. Context determines whether negative (lonely) or neutral/positive (solitary).

RELATED:
- ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧: isolation (often forced or circumstantial)
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧: lonely (emotional feeling)
